about_the_game:
Deck building

The deck is the body and the cards are its members. Congregation is only just as strong as its weakest link.

Card Collection

Fill your collection by buying cards or opening packs.

Player VS Player

Casual and ranked mode.

Story mode (WIP)

Play through the books of the bible made alive and unlock rewards!

Colosseum (WIP)

Battle online for increasing rewards with limited deck building.

7 Classes

Saint - Blessed by God, you are called to heal and build what is left to ruin and destruction. Your hands rebuild what sin and strife have undone.

Shepherd - Animals of the earth are you friends. You protect them and they provide for you. The more the merrier.

Gardener - A child of nature, your power flows from natural growth. Your options branch and spread, like the plants that thrive under your care.


King - Crowned by divine right, your word is command and your will is law. Under your rule, men and nations prosper with a blessing.

System - A disembodied spirit in a man-made vessel, your unholy passion is to enslave and destroy mankind. Tech is your realm, and all machines march for you.



Traitor - A criminal, thief, and robber, your life is defined by murder, plot, and betrayal. Gold is your god, and betrayal your prayer.


Occultist - The enemy of all good, you pay a terrible price to gain temporary power, your power is vast, your torment certain.

content_descriptors.notes: Content can trigger emotional reactions to those who are very opinionated of their world views and intolerant of other's culture and beliefs.
